icpc.title: ICPC South America-North Finals 2021
icpc.subtitle: Contestant · The 2021 ICPC South America-North Finals

modal.storyP1: TCO19 South America was a regional competitive programming event within Topcoder's international circuit. Qualifying and participating was an incredible opportunity. I was surrounded by extraordinarily talented people, and having the chance to connect with them, learn, compete, and experience that environment firsthand sparked in me a strong desire to keep improving, shift my mindset, and take my professional growth more seriously.

Facebook Colombia Hack 2020 was a hackathon organized by Facebook in Bogotá that brought together selected students from across the country to solve programming challenges, collaborate in teams, and exchange knowledge.
modal.storyP2: I qualified to participate based on my performance in Facebook Hacker Cup. During the event, I teamed up with friends from UTP, whom I especially value because we had also shared the experience of attending the 2019 Competitive Programming Bootcamp in Córdoba, Argentina.
